title: turraea grandifolia
intro: Turraea grandifolia, commonly known as the African dogwood or African iron tree, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae, native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Turraea grandifolia are attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
